challenge: Legs day after Wednesday's upper session. New Buffalo is sunny and dry, about 63–64°F from noon to 4 PM with light wind. Do a moderate Total Gym leg session, an easy run-walk, and a little core; keep it a couple of reps short of failure.
constraint: Labs are Tue Oct 27, 10:20 AM. Train normally through the weekend, but keep it moderate (nothing to failure) Oct 25–26.
items: Total Gym legs: 3 x 12 squats + 3 x 12 single-leg calf raises, moderate incline
Easy 25–30 min run-walk (alternate 3 min jog / 2 min walk), early afternoon (~63°F, light wind)
Core: 3 x 30 sec plank + 3 x 12 dead bugs
